title: Customer Authorization Terms for Additional Work on Customer-Pay Repairs
content:
## Clause

Work beyond the quote is never performed or charged without the customer's own approval. The customer's additional-work approval for that item is approved. The desk issues the request with its amount and labor hours and the job pauses; the customer answers within the tier's response window in hours of the request, and a request not answered in that time lapses as declined and work resumes on the quoted scope. Once approved additional work (the additional work already approved on the repair order plus the new item) would exceed the tier's new-estimate percentage of the quoted total, no further approval is issued and the customer is offered a new estimate instead. An approved item posts an additional work charge carrying its approval reference.

This clause governs Customer-Pay Repairs repair orders.

## Condition on charging additional work

> The customer's additional-work approval for that item is approved.

The system record decides it: the additional-work approval of that very item, with its status approved, matched to the charge by the approval reference the charge carries.

## How the request runs

- Issuing the request pauses the job: the repair order moves from in repair to awaiting approval.
- An answer, approval or decline, within the response window, or the lapse of the window, returns the job to in repair. A lapsed request counts as declined, and work resumes on the quoted scope.
- Approved additional work so far is the total of the additional work charges on the repair order over its life.

## New-estimate threshold (hypothetical Panel Repair Service order: threshold 50 percent, quoted total 2000.00, additional work already approved 700.00)

| New item | Approved additional work with the new item | Compared with 1000.00 (50 percent of 2000.00) | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 250.00 | 950.00 | below | the threshold does not bar an approval request |
| 300.00 | 1000.00 | equal, not above | the threshold does not bar an approval request |
| 300.01 | 1000.01 | above | no further approval; a new estimate is offered |

## Response window (hypothetical Panel Repair Service request, 48 hours)

- Request issued 2026-05-12 at 09:00; the customer approves on 2026-05-13 at 15:00, 30 hours later: the item is approved, posts its additional work charge with its approval reference, and work resumes.
- Same request, no answer by 2026-05-14 at 10:00, 49 hours later: the request has lapsed as declined and work resumes on the quoted scope; no additional work charge posts for the item.
